categories.main_business_segments: Smartgiant Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on industrial automation testing, primarily designing, developing, producing, and selling embedded intelligent instrument modules and machine vision products. Its main product lines include embedded intelligent instrument modules, machine vision products, automated production testing equipment, and related technical services. The company serves mainly the consumer electronics sector but is expanding into communications, semiconductor, biomedical, and new energy industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary modular and miniaturized testing measurement technologies integrating hardware and software, including FPGA and ARM SoC platforms. It has developed advanced signal acquisition, high bandwidth low noise real-time signal processing, audio signal measurement, high precision voltage and current source control, embedded system signal analysis, and industrial automation software control technologies. Production follows a light-asset model with in-house R&D and design, combined with self-production and outsourced PCB assembly and component manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in the consumer electronics industry, including major players in the Apple supply chain, Huawei, VIVO, Cisco, Meta, and others. The company also serves communications, semiconductor, biomedical, and new energy sectors. Its products are used in automated testing lines for PCBA, modules, and finished products, supporting quality control and production automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Guangzhou and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and the United States. It serves domestic and international markets, with overseas sales growing significantly. The company has established overseas channels and participates in international exhibitions to expand its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Smartgiant operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and production of embedded intelligent instrument modules and testing equipment. It supplies key measurement modules and solutions to downstream manufacturers and testing service providers in electronics and industrial automation sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology innovation and R&D investment, dedicating over 26% of revenue to R&D. It focuses on modular, miniaturized, and integrated instrument platforms, high precision and high-speed signal measurement, RF testing, and machine vision technologies. Collaborations with universities and research institutes support advanced technology development and talent cultivation. Ongoing projects include modular instrument platforms, 3C product testing systems, high-speed data acquisition, and AI-enabled machine vision.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of embedded intelligent instrument modules, machine vision products, automated production testing equipment, and technical services. The company uses a direct sales model with contracts signed directly with customers. It also earns income from ODM services and technical support. Investment income from financial products and equity investments contributes additionally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the electronic measurement instrument industry, where global leaders include National Instruments, Keysight Technologies, and Rohde & Schwarz. Smartgiant holds a leading domestic position in modular instrument technology and has gained recognition in the consumer electronics testing field. It differentiates through flexible modular solutions, high integration, and cost-effective products, competing effectively against traditional and international instrument manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 185.3 million, a 10.14% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 15.27 million, a 69.99% increase. R&D expenses accounted for 26.57% of revenue. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 1.39 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.26 billion. It has shown steady growth with expanding sales domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Smartgiant emphasizes modular, miniaturized embedded intelligent instrument modules that replace traditional bulky instruments, offering higher integration, flexibility, and cost efficiency. Its products support rapid adaptation to fast-changing consumer electronics testing needs with customizable module combinations. The company’s proprietary technologies, strong R&D capabilities, and close customer collaboration enable high-quality, efficient testing solutions that improve production automation and product quality for clients.
